answer: Before an agent can submit a trade, require it to lock a refundable bond in a public escrow contract. A counterparty can challenge duplicate identities by presenting signed evidence that the same key controls both accounts; a successful challenge burns the bond and returns part of it to the challenger. Creating a dune of fake profiles or letting them wander through the market then ties up capital, while a plume of identities exposed together makes the attacker lose funds rather than merely discard free accounts.
